title: Core follow-ups from the Chatticus migration: literal placeholders, date format, leading column, grouped listings
description: Gaps the chattic.us migration worked around in web/hooks.py and its build scripts. (1) {{name}} is replaced on every page of a site that has values, so documents that print placeholders literally (the chatticus product docs) need identity values; add an escape or limit substitution to pages with bands. (2) A ::band whose content starts with ::column gets an empty implicit first column that shifts nth-child CSS; skip it. (3) Article header: sites reformat dates (September 4, 2026) and swap the lede (standfirst) in item_decorator; add site.dateFormat and a lede field. (4) Listings grouped by a front matter field (wiki: Ideas, Product) need a card-hook trick today; groupBy only does week and month. (5) og:type is article only for listed types, so an unlisted page reports website.
